name: ua_oblast_massive3_base_v1
target_doc: oblast massed-strike day D (Kyiv calendar day): missiles >= 7 or strike drones >= 20 in the oblast (FPV excluded), as ob_massive2. Known negatives: those of ob_massive2 (complete OVA summary; no oblast alert while the alert feed was alive) plus every day of an ACLED week with no strike, shelling or interception event in the oblast (features.label_oblast3, table acled_weekly). Otherwise unknown
features_doc: region indicators, region base rate shrunk toward the all-oblast rate (shrink = pseudo-days), own target at D-2 and its 7-day mean; base/y2/y2_m7 from the real-time target ob_massive2 (lag_target), plus acled_l (log1p ACLED strike events of the oblast, latest week published before the cutoff) and acled_m8 (its 8-week mean): the oblast's real strike rate
